title: Screening Collapse under Recursive Synthetic Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.15617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive synthetic-data training can degrade a fitted model, but its effects on the variable-screening stage that precedes model fitting are less understood. When each generation labels data for the next, a marginal screener ranks variables against the current pseudo-label target rather than the original response. Across generations, this target drift can erode or reverse the active--inactive score margin and cause screening to discard variables that clean-label screening would retain. We call this process \emph{screening collapse}. In a Gaussian linear model with minimum-norm recursive generators, we establish finite-sample screening bounds, characterize a late-generation information-loss limit, and derive a minimax impossibility result. translated_title: 递归合成数据下的筛选崩溃
translated_abstract: 递归合成数据训练会使拟合的模型发生退化，但其对模型拟合之前的变量筛选阶段的影响却鲜有研究。当每一代为下一代标注数据时，边际筛选器是针对当前的伪标签目标而非原始响应变量来对变量进行排序。随着代次推进，这种目标漂移会侵蚀甚至逆转活跃变量与非活跃变量之间的分数差距，导致筛选过程丢弃真实标签筛选本应保留的变量。我们将这一过程称为“筛选崩溃”（screening collapse）。在具有最小范数递归生成器的高斯线性模型中，我们建立了有限样本筛选界，刻画了后期代次的信息损失极限，并推导了一个极小极大不可能性结果。筛选崩溃可以先于并加剧普通的模型崩溃：被遗漏的变量会产生一种协方差加权的损失，任何仅限于已选变量的重新拟合都无法消除该损失，而递归……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次揭示递归合成数据训练中的“筛选崩溃”现象：伪标签目标逐代漂移会侵蚀或逆转活跃与非活跃变量的分数差距，导致真实标签筛选本应保留的重要变量被丢弃，且这种协方差加权损失无法通过后续重新拟合消除，从而先于并加剧传统的模型崩溃。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "screening collapse" in recursive synthetic-data training: drift of the pseudo-label target across generations erodes or reverses the active-inactive score margin, causing screening to discard variables that clean-label screening would retain—an irrecoverable covariance-weighted loss that precedes and compounds ordinary model collapse.
